edit.statement: Every Roman legion of the early Empire was commanded by a military tribune.
edit.subject: A Roman legion of the early Empire
edit.original: Every Roman legion of the early Empire was commanded by a legate (legatus legionis).
edit.scope: Legions of the early Empire (from Augustus); Republican practice, when tribunes could share command, is outside the edit.
